usage: Use 樂譜 to mean written music notation or a printed score for playing or singing a piece.
Very common in music classes, choir practice, and when talking about piano, violin, or band arrangements.
It can refer to both a single sheet and a full score set, depending on the context.
Learners often hear it with verbs like 睇、跟、搵、買, meaning to read, follow, find, or buy sheet music.
